title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Grape Berry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elf Bar ElfLiq Grape Berry delivers a bold and flavourful combination of rich, dark Grapes and a medley of sweet, vibrant Berries. The deep, juicy flavour of Black Grape forms the tantalising base of this unique flavour, offering authentic sweetness with a touch of tartness. A blend of mixed Berries enhances the profile, adding layers of bright, tangy fruit notes for a smooth and well-balanced vape. Blended for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this 50/50 VG/PG nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Best suited for low-powered pod kits and starter vape devices, Grape Berry provides a full-bodied fruit flavour with discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Elf Bar ElfLiq brings the most popular Elf Bar disposable flavours into a 10ml e-liquid format, providing a cost-effective and sustainable way to enjoy signature flavours.
